conditional_model: Transform only the published table information under R(t)=2^(-t/T),where every admissible half-life Tis finite and strictly positive. Treat a table_point as an exact number only within this computational teaching model,greater_than as a strict bound,and unknown as no information beyond0<T<infinity. This does not assert measured first-order kinetics or a sample-specific half-life.
terminal_policy: Use the first supplied encoded residue literally;no cleavage,initiator-Met removal,PTM or mature-chain inference. These short strings are analytical index inputs,not functional sequence designs.
reporting: Return sharp lower and upper remaining-fraction bounds and whether each endpoint is attained,in source case order. A point interval has both endpoints attained. Preserve tiny positive values;do not round them to zero. IDs are unordered.
